The '''Rihkxyrk (rik-zerk) Assault Fighter''' was a heavy assault fighter built by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]].<ref name="Sony" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Rihkxyrk_Heavy_Starfighter.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Multiple views of a Rihkxyrk]]
The Rihkxyrk was a relatively sluggish fighter, but this was compensated for by its good defenses and weapons loadout.<ref name="Sony" /> It was one of the most heavily armed and armored starfighters of the [[Rebellion era]].<ref name="RECG" />

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:VaksaiRihkxyrk-RECG.png|thumb|left|200px|A Rihkxyrk fighter flying in formation with two Vaksai starfighters]]</div>
The ship was used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization as well as other criminal groups during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
The ship's tight defenses led to many Rihkxyrk pilots having a high sense of confidence in their own abilities as well as that of their ships, after surviving undamaged in many heavy conflicts.<ref name="Sony" />
